# Pre-refactor validation — {context}

## Scope and Authority

Actual date; mode/domain; source links/anchors/identity; approved paths/exclusions;
inspected dependencies versus write authority; base/target fingerprints; actual
analysis result/report/hash. No approval inferred from implementation.

## Critical Path Evidence

| Goal / AC / Type | Path / Caller / Risk | Base / Target Source Hashes | Test / Doc / Config Hashes | Date / Command / CWD | Exit / Result | Applicability / Limits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {stable approved identifiers} | {happy/error/edge and boundaries} | {actual hashes or unavailable} | {actual hashes} | {executed check or not executed} | {actual exit/result or null} | {required/optional; stale/unavailable/failed disposition} |

Retain unchanged expectations. New regressions and required unresolved critical
paths block readiness; report baseline and unrelated failures without masking.

## Measurements and Counts

Coverage before/after; method/scope/denominator; comparable or not measured;
actual null when unmeasured; broad 80% guideline versus applicable authoritative
policy. Score number|null with actual rubric, no synthetic aggregate. Actual
distinct docs_created/docs_updated/tests_added/tests_updated paths/counting basis.

## Findings and Readiness

Classify descriptive drift versus approved-behavior bug versus intentional CR.
Operation success distinct from ready_for_refactoring; study readiness=false.
Required gaps/authority/disposition; verified engineering delivery versus not
measured stakeholder outcome. No source repair or changed approved acceptance.

## Original Output and Consumer Limits

Original operation_output fields/nesting plus supplied extensions; scope/target
goals/suggestions/principles and code_alignment passed through exactly. Actual
report path/errors. Strict nullable/status consumer compatibility not assumed.
